title: The Coin in the Soil
lines: A boy named Nick dug in the soil.
His toy spade tapped a hard, flat thing.
It was a coin, black with mud.
Nick made a lot of happy noise.
Meg ran up to join him.
They dug up a tin box of coins!
Mom said, "We will boil the mud off."

questions.ask: What did the toy spade tap?
questions.listenFor: A hard, flat thing that was a coin. Have them find the line.

questions.ask: What did Nick and Meg dig up in the end?
questions.listenFor: A tin box full of coins - more than the one coin.

questions.ask: What would you do with a box of old coins? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. Listen for a reason of their own.
